notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 2.
description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Karametra's Acolyte.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.
